name: MINILLA
about: New (PAD-658). Shots up the Mecha lane wake him at its top (6, 12, then 18); four stages (smoke rings, the tail stomp and his first ray, beating the bully Gabara, a father-and-son two-ball multiball), the line naming the shots each one wants; cash the pot out at the right scoop. Son of Godzilla (1967) and All Monsters Attack (1969).

intro.what: Newly hatched Minilla turns his head and grins up at Godzilla, close up, 0:34:35.

loop.what: A run of shots on the beach: Minilla toddles ahead, Godzilla looks on, then the two walk side by side, 0:45:11.

ring.what: Minilla puffs out his cheeks and blows a little smoke ring, close up, 0:39:41.

puff.what: Minilla blows a smoke ring from between Gabara's legs and it lands on Gabara's head like a halo, 0:47:41.

stomp.what: A run of shots: Minilla strains beside Godzilla, then Godzilla's foot comes down on Minilla's tail, 0:51:41.

ray.what: Minilla shoots his first real atomic ray, then the beam hits the ground, 0:51:42.

gabara.what: Gabara snarls into the camera, close up, 0:47:38.

gabara_hit.what: A run of shots: Minilla jumps on the see-saw log and Gabara is flung high through the sky, 0:51:41.

mb.what: Godzilla and Minilla stand side by side in the valley, ready to fight, 0:52:09.

won.what: Minilla hugs Godzilla in the falling snow, 1:23:34.

lost.what: Minilla stands alone in the snow crying, then slumps, 1:21:57.

cashout.what: Godzilla and Minilla huddle together asleep under the snow, 1:24:41.

music.what: The gentle father-and-son theme over the snowy ending of Son of Godzilla, a clean loop with no effects, 1:25:12.

cry.what: Baby Minilla's two chirping cries just after hatching, 0:34:36.

ring.what: Three soft puffs as Minilla blows a smoke ring for Godzilla, 0:51:24.

stomp.what: A heavy crash as Gabara slams into the ground, 0:51:47.

ray.what: The hissing roar of Minilla's first real atomic ray, 0:51:42.

gabara.what: Gabara bellows with his arms raised, over the score, 0:48:59.

jackpot.what: Godzilla roars on the hillside before showing Minilla his ray, 0:50:19.

won.what: Godzilla's victory roar with his arms raised after saving the hatchling, 0:34:26.

lost.what: Minilla's sad cry beside Godzilla in the freezing snow, 1:21:55.
